name: Technex Solutions
description: PC booster by TechNex Labs intended to improve system performance and running efficiency.
caution: User-provided RAR archive hosted on MediaFire. Its contents have not been independently reviewed; scan it before extracting or running.

name: Android SDK Platform-Tools
description: Official command-line package that includes ADB and Fastboot.
caution: Fastboot can erase data or brick a device when used with an incompatible image.

name: Apple Support: iTunes
description: Apple software and support hub for device management, backups, updates, and restore.
caution: Restores erase device data; back up first when possible.

name: 3uTools
description: Third-party iOS device management utility. Review privacy and restore implications.
caution: Not affiliated with Apple. Verify each operation.

name: iMazing
description: Commercial Apple device management and backup software.
caution: Some features require a license.

name: Samsung Smart Switch
description: Official support hub for content transfer and software update workflows.
caution: Availability varies by region, device, and OS.

name: Nmap
description: Network discovery and security auditing utility.
caution: Scan only systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.

name: Wireshark
description: Network protocol analyzer for authorized troubleshooting and learning.
caution: Packet captures can contain private data; protect capture files.

name: Kali Linux
description: Security-focused Linux distribution for testing, forensics, and education.
caution: Verify images and work only in an authorized lab.

name: Burp Suite Community Edition
description: Manual web application security testing toolkit with proxy, repeater, decoder, and related features.
caution: Use only with applications you own or have explicit authorization to test. Review proxy settings before capturing traffic.

name: Metasploit Framework
description: Open-source framework for security research and authorized penetration testing; official documentation and installers are linked.
caution: Exploit modules can disrupt systems or access data. Practice only in isolated labs or within written scope.

name: sqlmap
description: Open-source tool for testing SQL injection and database security in authorized environments.
caution: Automated testing can alter or expose data. Use a local lab or obtain explicit authorization and scope.

name: Hashcat
description: Password recovery and password-hash auditing utility with official downloads and documentation.
caution: Use only on password hashes you own or are authorized to audit. Keep recovered credentials private and protected.

name: John the Ripper
description: Open-source password security auditing and recovery tool; consult Openwall for source, platform builds, and verification guidance.
caution: Audit only credentials and hashes you own or have written permission to assess.

name: Aircrack-ng
description: Wireless network security assessment suite with project documentation and download resources.
caution: Wireless capture and testing requires network-owner authorization and compatible hardware. Never target third-party networks.

name: Gobuster
description: Open-source Go utility for authorized web path, DNS, and virtual-host discovery.
caution: Discovery requests can load target services. Restrict use to owned or explicitly authorized systems.

name: dirsearch
description: Open-source web path discovery tool with installation and usage documentation in its project repository.
caution: Use only within an approved scope. Requests may expose private endpoints or affect service availability.

name: Nikto
description: Open-source web server scanner; the project and maintainer pages provide current source and usage notes.
caution: Scanning can generate substantial traffic and reveal sensitive server details. Test only authorized hosts.

name: Subfinder
description: Passive subdomain discovery tool with official installation and usage documentation.
caution: Use only for domains within your authorized scope. Passive source APIs may require accounts or keys; do not expose secrets.

name: ffuf
description: Open-source web fuzzer for controlled testing and learning in local labs or explicitly authorized targets.
caution: Fuzzing can create high request volume. Keep rates low and use only within an authorized scope.

name: Android Studio
description: Official integrated development environment for Android application development and Android SDK management.
caution: Large developer toolchain. Install only from Google and review current system requirements and SDK licenses.

name: Google USB Driver
description: Windows USB driver for supported Google Android devices; other brands should use their OEM driver instructions.
caution: Use only for supported Google devices. Driver requirements differ by operating system and manufacturer.

name: Android OEM USB driver index
description: Manufacturer driver links and setup guidance for Android development connections on Windows.
caution: Select the exact phone manufacturer and model. Avoid third-party repackaged driver bundles.

name: Android Flash Tool
description: Google browser-based flashing tool for supported Pixel devices and listed builds.
caution: Pixel-only where listed. Flashing or unlocking can erase data; never use with other brands or unlisted variants.

name: Apple Devices for Windows
description: Apple Windows app for managing, backing up, updating, and restoring supported iPhone and iPad devices.
caution: A restore erases device contents. Apple Account and Activation Lock remain subject to the owner’s credentials.

name: MTKClient
description: Open-source MediaTek device utility and research project; consult its own repository for documented scope and supported devices.
caution: Low-level device access may read or write protected storage. Use only on devices you own or are authorized to service; support is device-specific and may be destructive.

name: OWASP ZAP
description: Open-source web application security testing proxy and scanner for development and authorized testing.
caution: Active scans generate traffic and may affect services. Use only in local labs or within explicit written scope.

name: Google Chrome
description: Official browser download page for supported desktop operating systems.
caution: Download from Google only; review browser permissions and sync settings.

name: VLC media player
description: Free, open-source media player with official installers and checksums.
caution: Use the official VideoLAN download page; avoid bundled third-party installers.

name: LibreOffice
description: Free office suite for documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and more.
caution: Choose the correct operating system and language from the official project page.

name: 7-Zip
description: Open-source file archiver with official downloads for Windows.
caution: Choose the correct 64-bit or ARM64 package; never download repackaged builds.
